ThingDef.label: magier sigil
ThingDef.description: An implant and identification code used by the Colonization Fleet's tactical magier corps to mark a caster's identity - usually so that members of the fleet do not realize who they were dealing with only after making a grave mistake. Beyond identification, it uses transcendent power to bind the place the caster's subconscious holds to be safest, so that when they lose consciousness or come close to death it raises a space-folding field to carry them out of danger, and to keep them from falling into enemy hands alive.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> when the bearer goes down, 80% chance to stop their bleeding and teleport them - beside a bed in the colony for the player, off the map for anyone else. When the bearer dies, the body is teleported the same way. Does nothing for prisoners, slaves, or under anaesthesia.
